item.description:
Kento Alpha 0.9.15, build 2526

Viewer

  • Fixed: a Viewer left on the default display showed the config's default view instead of the comp's Viewer's display. A new ACES 2.0 comp, set to Un-tone-mapped, showed white as gray. Viewers now show the comp's display and follow it when it changes, until you choose a view on the bar.
  • tone map, after the view menu, switches in one click between the config's tone-mapped view (an ACES view: 1.0 shows as a light gray, highlights roll off) and Un-tone-mapped (1.0 shows as white). It's dim for a config whose views don't tone-map.
  • On a narrow Viewer the display menu folds into ... before the view menu, so the view's name stays in sight.

Properties

  • Right-click a number field for the control's menu, with Reset to default, keys, expressions, and copy and paste, instead of the text menu.
  • The mask row has a second line with inject, under invert: it copies the mask into the output's mask.a.
  • invert beside (un)premult by now works on Add and Multiply too.
  • CameraShake's center shows the input's middle, where it turns, until you set your own.

Node Graph

  • Detailed labels: under each node, after its label, up to two of its controls that differ from their defaults, for example "size 12 filter box" under a Blur, or a Transform's moves. Right-click a node for Hide Details or Hide Details on Every (its class). Settings > Node Graph has detailed labels and the classes you've hidden.
  • Unused inputs fold away: an empty mask input or a merge's spare A inputs show only while the pointer is on the node or you drag a wire. Select nodes and press Shift+H (Edit > Show Inputs) to keep theirs showing. fold unused inputs in Settings turns it off.

Color

  • A MatchGrade on one of Asobi's methods now saves to a .nk as a group Nuke renders the same: the fitted cube between conversions into and out of the color timing space. The cube is copied beside the script. Kento opens the group as the MatchGrade again.
  • Kento's own labels, tabs, menus and tips now spell it color: Settings > Color, the comp panel's and Read's Color tabs, Utility > Color checker and the rest. The manual too.

3D

  • PositionToPoints2 and CameraTrackerPointCloud draw their point clouds in the 3D view: a point for each sampled pixel of the position pass in the picture's colors, and the tracker's solved points.

Settings

  • bento libraries, gizmo folders and pixel kernel libraries are lists: a folder a line with Remove beside it, and Add folder... to choose one, for a studio's shared gizmos or Bentos.

Remote control

  • viewer.look reports the Viewer's display transform: display, view, look, where they came from and the comp's own Viewer's display. viewer.set_look takes a display and a view (default follows the comp's again).

Kento Alpha 0.9.14, build 2522

Mask controls: fringe and inject

  • fringe works on every node with Nuke's mask controls: the effect lands on the mask's soft edges only, strongest where the mask is half on. With invert, everywhere but the edges. Measured against NukeX and matched.
  • inject copies the mask into the output's mask.a channel, to use again further down. It's set in a .nk or over Remote control; the panel's mask row has no place for it.
  • invert beside (un)premult by now works on Grade, ColorCorrect, HueCorrect, HueShift, ColorLookup, ColorMatrix, Colorspace, Expression, Log2Lin and ScannedGrain: the color is divided by one minus alpha instead. Not yet on Add, Multiply and the other math nodes.

Planar tracking

  • Multipass runs in the background by default, as the design has it: keep working while the passes track, the button reading Stop; Accept wakes when they're done.
  • Roto's Tracking tab: follow a track keys the motion of a PlanarTracker already in the comp into the layer or shapes, without tracking again. Pick it in the menu beside the button, then Analyze.
  • points moved by the plane keys the shapes' own points where the plane takes them, instead of the transform, so you can correct them on top.

Paint

  • Wire removal's fill menu is live: other frames takes each pixel from the picture two frames either side, where the wire has moved off (for a camera that holds still); a clean plate takes the RotoPaint's bg1 input, its tone matched at the stroke's edge. Aligning frames or a plate by a track isn't in Kento yet.

Playback

  • A Flipbook rendering while the Viewer plays now adds its frames to the Timeline's green line beside the Viewer's, instead of the two wiping each other's out.

Kento Alpha 0.9.13, build 2511

Planar tracker: multipass

  • A Multipass section on the PlanarTracker's Track tab. passes picks single, forward and back, or multipass.
  • Under vary, each toggle adds a pass that changes one thing: direction, tracker, reference (the frames under refs), motion model, channel or search.
  • score by rates each frame of each pass by its confidence, its agreement with the other passes, and its smoothness. combine takes the most consistent path, each frame from the best pass with switch cost for a change, or the best single pass. smooth the joins blends where the pass changes.
  • Track all passes tracks them; nothing is keyed until Accept. Use pass for range uses one pass from in to out, and Discard drops the run. A graph shows each pass and the combined track.
  • Running in the background is on the menu, dim: the passes run now, with their progress.

Tracker: the planar track row

  • The Tracker's planar track row now sits in Tracking, as the design has it: the PlanarTracker menu, then guide search, fill gaps and points on it as toggles.
  • With points on it on, Add makes a track that rides the plane. The Point on the plane button is gone.

Links

  • Edit > Link (Alt+L) puts a link to each selected node beside it. Like a clone, its settings are its source's, both ways, keys included.
  • Edit > Unlink (Shift+Alt+L) makes links nodes of their own. Edit > Copy As Links (Alt+Cmd+L) puts links on the clipboard to paste.
  • A .nk writes links as Nuke does, and Nuke opens them as links. A script's links open in Kento as links; a link whose source is missing opens as a node of its own, and the load report says so.

MatchGrade

  • mask works with Asobi's methods too: the curves and matrix fit reads where both pictures' alpha say so, the other methods each picture by its own.
  • Before fitting, Asobi's curves and matrix now finds where the source sits in the target's frame: fitted, filling the frame or stretched, then blown up and moved a little. The closest match is kept, and the line beside Analyze says where the source was placed.
  • Bars are left out of the target only, as Asobi now does, and the histogram match no longer fails on an empty side.

Playback

  • The held frames are no longer let go at every play and stop. Play, stop and play again now plays from what's held.
  • A frame much bigger than the Viewer shows it is held smaller, as sharp as the screen can show it, so more frames fit and they're ready sooner. hold big frames at screen size, in Settings > Preferences > Performance, turns it off.
  • The picture past the format (overscan, or a move off it) plays from the cache too, as does the Clipping warning and Absolute values.

Roto

  • A point added on a B-spline or X-spline (Cmd+Alt-click) goes where you click on the curve. It had been placed at the middle of the control polygon, which pulled the curve away.

Remote control

  • planar.multipass and node.clone (clone, declone, link and unlink) are new.
